description: Polish bakery that sells only in its own shops: the exclusion applies.

criteria.target_business: Producer of packaged bakery products for supermarket chains
criteria.exclusions: businesses that only sell through their own retail shops

html: Mała Piekarnia runs five neighbourhood bakery shops in Kraków, Poland.
We bake fresh every morning and sell only in our own shops.

label_rationale: The bakery states it sells only in its own shops: the retail-only exclusion applies, and it does not supply supermarket chains (target business not met).
